req.title: Task title max length
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title exceeds the maximum length constraint.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should return an HTTP 422 status code when the task title exceeds the maximum length constraint. This implies that the system has a validation mechanism for task titles, and we need to test this mechanism by providing inputs that are within, at, and beyond the boundary of the maximum length. This will ensure that the system correctly handles valid inputs and rejects invalid ones.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_title_length
preconditions: The task title length is within the allowed maximum length.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of maximum allowed length.
expected: The system responds with HTTP 201 Created.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "a" * 100, "description": "Valid description", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "a" * 100

tests.name: test_create_task_with_exceeding_title_length
preconditions: The task title length exceeds the allowed maximum length.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title exceeding the maximum allowed length.
expected: The system responds with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "a" * 101, "description": "Exceeding description", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422

tests.name: test_create_task_with_boundary_title_length
preconditions: The task title length is exactly at the maximum allowed length.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a title of exactly maximum allowed length.
expected: The system responds with HTTP 201 Created.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "a" * 100, "description": "Boundary description", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "a" * 100
